en: A heavy load that you carry; or something difficult or worrying that you have to deal with; or to give someone a heavy load.
ex: The tax increase is a heavy burden on poor families.
增稅對貧窮家庭是沉重的負擔。

en: A sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement under the Earth's surface.
ex: A strong earthquake hit the island last night.
昨晚一場強烈地震襲擊了這座島。

en: To say firmly that something must be done; or to refuse to change your opinion.
ex: She insisted on paying for the dinner.
她堅持要付晚餐的錢。

en: To take something away from a place; or to take something off; or to get rid of something.
ex: Please remove your shoes before entering the house.
進屋前請脫鞋。

en: Of a higher quality or standard than something else; or in a more healthy state; or in a more effective way.
ex: I feel much better after taking the medicine.
吃了藥之後我覺得好多了。

en: A small, round piece of bread; or a hairstyle in which hair is gathered into a round knot at the back of the head.
ex: She had a sweet bun and tea for breakfast.
她早餐吃了一個甜麵包配茶。

en: A long thin fiber that carries messages between your brain and body; or courage; or being bold.
ex: It takes nerve to speak in front of a large crowd.
在大批群眾面前說話需要勇氣。

en: A young sheep; or the meat of a young sheep.
ex: The little lamb followed its mother across the field.
小羊跟著媽媽穿過田野。

en: The power to change how someone thinks or acts; or to have an effect on someone or something.
ex: Parents have a big influence on their children.
父母對孩子有很大的影響。

en: A shiny, gray-white metal used to make jewelry, coins and cutlery; or the color of this metal.
ex: She wore a beautiful silver necklace.
她戴著一條漂亮的銀項鍊。

en: An unpleasant event that is not intended and causes injury or damage; or something that happens by chance.
ex: He was injured in a car accident last week.
他上週在車禍中受傷。

en: A small creature with eight legs that makes webs to catch insects.
ex: A spider was spinning a web in the corner.
一隻蜘蛛正在角落結網。

en: A sweet food made from fruit and sugar, spread on bread; or a mass of vehicles or people that cannot move; or to push into a small space.
ex: I spread some strawberry jam on my toast.
我在吐司上抹了一些草莓果醬。

en: A position of the body, especially for a photo or painting; or to ask a question; or to pretend.
ex: The model posed for the photographer.
模特兒為攝影師擺姿勢。

en: Something you do to earn money; or physical or mental effort; or to function in the right way.
ex: I go to work at eight o'clock every morning.
我每天早上八點去上班。

en: A person who listens, especially to the radio or to someone talking.
ex: She is a good listener and never interrupts people.
她是個很好的傾聽者，從不打斷別人說話。

en: Causing admiration because it is very good, large or important.
ex: The singer gave an impressive performance last night.
那位歌手昨晚的表演令人印象深刻。

en: To become the husband or wife of someone in a ceremony.
ex: They plan to marry next spring.
他們打算明年春天結婚。

en: Not controlled by another person or country; or able to take care of yourself without help.
ex: She became independent after she got her first job.
她找到第一份工作後就獨立了。

en: A piece of cloth that hangs at a window or in a theater; or a screen that hides something.
ex: She drew the curtains to keep out the sunlight.
她拉上窗簾擋住陽光。

en: A child who goes to school; or the dark round part in the center of your eye.
ex: The teacher asked each pupil to read a sentence.
老師請每位學生讀一個句子。

en: The fact of not being present; or a period when you are away; or a lack of something.
ex: His absence from school worried his teacher.
他缺課讓老師很擔心。

en: Not at a place where you are expected to be; or not existing in something.
ex: Three students were absent from class today.
今天有三名學生缺課。

en: To take something that is offered to you; or to agree to something; or to believe that something is true.
ex: She accepted the invitation to the party.
她接受了派對的邀請。

en: A record of money you have in a bank; or a spoken or written description of something that happened; or the reason for something.
ex: She opened a bank account to save her money.
她開了一個銀行帳戶存錢。

en: Doing a lot of things or using a lot of energy; or taking part in an activity; or working.
ex: He is an active member of the school club.
他是學校社團的活躍成員。

en: Something that you do for pleasure or as part of a plan; or a situation where there are a lot of things happening.
ex: There are many outdoor activities at the summer camp.
夏令營有許多戶外活動。

en: Real or existing; or the real facts, not an estimate; or happening now.
ex: The actual cost of the trip was lower than we thought.
這趟旅行的實際費用比我們想的低。

en: The details of where someone lives or works; or a formal speech; or to speak to someone.
ex: Please write your name and address on the form.
請在表格上寫下你的姓名和地址。

en: A person who is fully grown or legally old enough to be responsible; or fully grown.
ex: Children must be accompanied by an adult.
兒童必須由成人陪同。

en: To move forward; or to make progress; or progress in something; or happening before the expected time.
ex: Please book your tickets in advance.
請提前訂票。

en: An opinion that you give someone about what they should do.
ex: My teacher gave me some good advice about studying.
老師給了我一些關於念書的好建議。

en: A matter or situation that you have to deal with; or private business; or a romantic relationship.
ex: That is a private affair and none of your business.
那是私事，不關你的事。

en: In opposition to; or touching or leaning on something; or in competition with someone.
ex: The ladder is leaning against the wall.
梯子靠在牆上。

en: In front of someone or something; or forward in space or time; or winning.
ex: The road ahead is closed because of an accident.
前方的路因事故而封閉。

en: The purpose of what you are doing; or to point something at a target; or to try to do something.
ex: The aim of this course is to improve your speaking skills.
這門課的目標是改善你的口說能力。

en: Any vehicle that can fly, such as an airplane, helicopter or glider.
ex: The aircraft landed safely despite the storm.
儘管有暴風雨，飛機仍安全降落。

en: A sudden feeling of fear; or a loud noise that warns of danger; or to make someone worried.
ex: The fire alarm went off at midnight.
火警警報在午夜響起。

en: A book with empty pages for sticking in photos or stamps; or a collection of songs on a CD or in a music app.
ex: She showed us her photo album from the trip.
她給我們看了這趟旅行的相簿。

en: Very similar to each other; or in the same way.
ex: The twin sisters look so alike that nobody can tell them apart.
那對雙胞胎姊妹長得太像了，沒有人分得出來。
